scripts.dev: npm run env:sync && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @helali/backend" "npm run dev -w @helali/frontend"
scripts.env:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env')){ fs.copyFileSync('.env','apps/backend/.env'); fs.copyFileSync('.env','apps/frontend/.env.local'); } else if(fs.existsSync('.env.example')){ fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env'); fs.copyFileSync('.env','apps/backend/.env'); fs.copyFileSync('.env','apps/frontend/.env.local'); }"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run env:sync && npm run db:migrate -w @helali/backend
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run env:sync && npm run db:migrate:dev -w @helali/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run env:sync && npm run db:seed -w @helali/backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run env:sync && npm run dev -w @helali/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run env:sync && npm run dev -w @helali/frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @helali/shared && npm run db:generate -w @helali/backend
